title: Maximizing Memory-Level Parallelism via Integrated Stochastic Logic-in-Memory Architectures
summary: Replaces separate memory and processing in a von Neumann architecture with stochastic arithmetic inside MTJ memory arrays. It requires new hardware not available commercially, accepts precision limits from probabilistic bit streams, and lacks a conventional ML compilation pipeline. It cannot run on a GPU or through an API and requires fabricating magnetic devices.
rationale: Hardware-device research with no inference software that the reader can currently adopt or test.
